verdict.rationale: Aider works on your local git repo and can run against local models via Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible local API. That lets a user keep code and prompts on their own machine, or pick which provider receives them. However, the evidence never mentions any explicit region or data-residency setting or guarantee. Missing for 10: documented region/residency selection, stated data-storage and retention locations for the tool itself, independent corroboration of on-machine data handling.
